```php
class Holder { public array $items = [1, 2]; }
function bump(array &$a): void { foreach ($a as $k => $v) { $a[$k] = $v + 1; } }
$o = new Holder(); bump($o->items);
```

`Function 'bump' parameter $a must be passed a variable`. php has always allowed
a property there, and the refusal covered static properties and every scalar
type too, so a class that keeps state in a property could not hand it to any
by-reference helper it owns.
